reviews.comment: A masterclass in storytelling. The friendship between Andy and Red carries the whole film.
Slow at first, but the payoff is enormous. Hope is the real subject here.
Excellent performances throughout. Some pacing issues in the middle act.
Ledger's performance redefined what a villain could be. Tense from start to finish.
The ferry sequence alone is worth the runtime. Superb direction.
A bit long, but the moral tension keeps you engaged.
Character transformation done better than any show I've seen. Every season earns its ending.
Season 4's tension is almost unbearable in the best way. The writing never slips.
Starts slow, becomes unputdownable. The cinematography is gorgeous.
Comfort television at its finest. The ensemble cast is unmatched.
The later seasons lose a little steam after the cast shake-up, but still great.
Rewatchable in a way few sitcoms are. The documentary format holds up.
